summary: First full test pass on Life Manager (Foundation + Finance + light modules + AI). Backend: 23/23 pytest tests pass (auth, accounts, categories, people CRUD, transactions incl. shared item-level splitting, settlements decrementing balances, analytics summary, tasks, weight, groceries, meals, AI history/actions/chat wiring). Frontend: login, Home dashboard, Money page (stats + month select + add expense), shared item-split expense save, People page, Tasks add, Body weight add, Groceries/Nutrition/Settings navigation, QuickAdd person, Command bar (Ctrl+K), theme toggle, and AI assistant panel with input/send/mic/attach all work end-to-end via UI. AI /api/ai/chat actually returned a real assistant reply, so the Emergent LLM key currently has budget (contrary to the note in the request).

minor.issue: session_id is a required query param (422 if missing). Not a defect, just document; frontend correctly passes session_id.

ui_bugs.issue: Backdrop (fixed inset-0 z-40) intercepts clicks on side nav while AI panel is open; user must close panel before clicking nav. Non-blocking but slightly awkward.

issues: Radix DialogContent missing Description/aria-describedby — accessibility warnings in console.
QuickAdd dialog appears to be missing a DialogTitle (Radix error: 'DialogContent requires a DialogTitle for the component to be accessible for screen reader users').

action_items: Add DialogTitle (or VisuallyHidden wrapper) to QuickAdd dialog and any other DialogContent missing it.
Add DialogDescription or aria-describedby={undefined} explicit to silence Radix a11y warnings.
Consider closing the AI panel automatically on route change so users can click nav items without dismissing the backdrop first.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1047 lines — consider splitting into routers per module (finance, tasks, nutrition, ai) for maintainability.

people_balances() and compute_account_balance() perform full-collection scans for every request. Fine at MVP scale but will not scale — consider aggregation pipelines or caching once transaction volume grows.
/api/transactions/{tid} DELETE does not restore inventory items added via add_to_inventory. Not a correctness issue for balances but leaves orphaned groceries.
compute_shares in expense engine keeps shares only if v>0 OR key=='Me', silently dropping other zero-share participants — reasonable but worth documenting.
No rate limiting or brute-force protection on /api/auth/login (single-user app so lower priority).

success_rate.frontend: 100% of exercised flows (login, nav, expense simple + shared item-split, tasks, body, groceries, nutrition, settings, quick add person, command bar, theme toggle, AI panel)

seed_data_creation: Test data auto-cleaned by tests. UI flow created PW_bob person, PW_TEST_shop / PW_shared expenses, PW_TEST_task, weight 82.3 — these remain in DB (single-user app, prefixes make them identifiable).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests are in /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py — 23 tests covering all core CRUD + finance split correctness + settlements. Run: cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/backend_test.py -v. AI chat currently succeeds (real Gemini reply observed) — do NOT assume budget is exhausted. Small residual test data with 'PW_' prefix present in DB.
rca of the issue: No blocking issues found. Two minor UX/a11y items only: (1) missing DialogTitle/Description on some Radix dialogs (a11y warnings), (2) AI backdrop blocks left-nav clicks while open.
